ribb-megech-irrigation.displaced_label: households that lost all farmland and housing and were relocated to Ebinat and Debre Tabor towns (Ethiopian Ministry of Water, Irrigation and Energy relocation report of 2018, as given in Adefres, 2020)
ribb-megech-irrigation.displaced_note: The card's present figure of 10,409 is ICIJ's estimate and is not a count of people moved; it should be replaced. ICIJ gives 10,409 for this project, drawn from World Bank documents and current to 31 December 2014. The World Bank's completion report gives 6,618 project-affected persons identified and unpaid at the end of the project, covering both temporary loss of access to land during redistribution and construction and permanent relocation because of the Ribb dam and reservoir, and a table listing 226 eligible people at the Ribb dam and reservoir, 3,210 at Megech-Seraba and 3,180 at Ribb irrigation. A 2020 Addis Ababa University master's thesis, citing the Ethiopian ministry's 2018 relocation report, gives 1,486 affected households of whom 227 were relocated. The Bank's 1,486 is given as persons and the ministry's as households. The documents do not explain these differences and no document found reconciles them with ICIJ's figure.
